name: double-vulnerable-stack-seed0
description: Verifies VulnerablePower amount stacking semantics. Cultist has VulnerablePower(amount=4) (representing 4 stacks); player attacks for 6 raw → multiplier is still 1.5x (Python's Vulnerable returns the same VULNERABLE_MULTIPLIER regardless of stack count — duration vs strength) → 6 * 3/2 = 9 → cultist HP 48 - 9 = 39. The amount=4 round-trips through the parity exporter unchanged.
